data.content:
Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [Beautiful rugs, but...../](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6511d961746a0e25aebc7cfe)
Please get a better system for ordering rug samples. I ordered three, 3 x5 rugs. All were said to be in stock. Two came, and my favorite did not. I would not have ordered ANY of them if I had known my favorite wasn't available. Your website is not current with your available stock. So, I'm stuck paying for the return shipping on two rugs I would not have considered if I had known the accurate picture of availability

September 10, 2023

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Sep 25, 2023

Hi Helen,

Thank you for reaching out. Our warehouse team let me know that their inventory levels were incorrect when you placed your order and we, unfortunately, are out of stock of the Tahj Rug and we issued a full refund for this rug. We're deeply sorry for the inconvenience this has caused. If you would like to share any further feedback or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out to support@luluandgeorgia.com.
